bundle.shortDescription: PeDitX-AI's companion at the top of your screen
bundle.longDescription: PeDitX-Goo is the animated companion of PeDitX-AI, sitting at the top of your screen. It is a shell, not a second assistant: PeDitX-AI owns the persona, the memory, the Skills, the access mode, the model and the key. No telemetry, no account, and no secret of its own.
